items.title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
items.description: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers

items.title: Silicon Valley wants you to invest in miracles
items.description: Investing in any stock is kind of like gambling in the sense that you're betting your money on a company's future performance. items.title: Sam Altman sympathizes with mathematicians, but says OpenAI’s math onslaught won’t stop
items.description: After months of bombarding mathematicians with a relentless stream of AI-generated results, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says he sympathizes with researchers struggling to make sense of it all. items.tldr: OpenAIのCEOサム・アルトマンは、数学者たちの苦労に同情しつつも、AIによる数学の攻撃を止めるつもりはなく、今後さらに多くの成果が期待できると示唆しています。

items.title: 5 days left: Your last chance to connect, scale, and save at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
items.description: 5 days to save up to $100, plus a second pass for free to TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 in Boston on November 4. Register now.

items.title: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
items.description: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

items.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
items.description: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users. items.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
items.description: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

items.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
items.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

items.description: To anyone listening closely to what Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been saying over the past couple of years, this week felt like the clearest sign yet that AI is about to fundamentally change the size of Microsoft's workforce. items.tldr: AIによる問い合わせメールの振り分けに「要確認」の選択肢を追加することで、分類漏れや誤分類を防ぎ、重要なメールを適切に処理できることが実験で示されました。

items.tldr: 「Phantom Blade Zero」のディレクターは、このゲームが「ソウルライク」ではないと強調したが、発売初日にはPC向けのモッドがFromSoftwareの敵のリスポーンやボスのリセットを追加した。

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-118539 (CVSS score: N/A), is a case of missing authorization affecting Commerce Core versions from 0.0.0 to 2.41 and from 3.0.0 to 3.3.13. "Thi
items.tldr: Drupalは、Commerce Coreコンポーネントにおける「非常に重大な」セキュリティ脆弱性（CVE-2026-118539）が悪用されていることを警告しており、影響を受けるバージョンは0.0.0から2.41および3.0.0から3.3.13までです。

items.description: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said nearly $3 billion of those assets have been frozen on-chain so far.  Tether and Circle said they have frozen

items.title: Linuxカーネルの脆弱性 CVE-2026-98432 についてまとめてみた
items.description: 2026年10月15日、LinuxカーネルのCNAは、IPv4のTCP処理にあるuse-after-freeの脆弱性 CVE-2026-98432 を公開しました。ここでは関連する情報をまとめます。 どんな脆弱性が確認されたの? IPv4のTCP接続処理で、要求ソケットのIPオプションが解放された後も別のCPUが読み続けうるuse-after-freeが生じる。認証は不要で、接続を受け付けているサーバーにネットワーク経由で到達できる相手が対象になる。(出典: 2, 4) 発見と報告はAnthropic。(出典: 1, 16) Anthropicは10月27日の研究レポートで、この脆弱性を使った
items.tldr: LinuxカーネルのCVE-2026-98432は、IPv4のTCP処理におけるuse-after-freeの脆弱性で、解放されたソケットのIPオプションが別のCPUによって読み取られる可能性があり、認証なしで攻撃が可能です。
